items.title: MetaRoCE：为 AI 规模以太网打造的全新 RDMA 传输协议 / MetaRoCE： A New RDMA Transport Built for AI-Scale Ethernet

sources.title: MetaRoCE：为 AI 规模以太网打造的全新 RDMA 传输协议 / MetaRoCE： A New RDMA Transport Built for AI-Scale Ethernet
sources.title_zh: MetaRoCE：为 AI 规模以太网打造的全新 RDMA 传输协议
sources.title_en: MetaRoCE： A New RDMA Transport Built for AI-Scale Ethernet
sources.title_original: MetaRoCE： A New RDMA Transport Built for AI-Scale Ethernet
sources.summary: Meta 设计并开源了 MetaRoCE，一个专为 AI 工作负载在通用以太网上打造的 RDMA 传输协议，已通过 Open Compute Project（OCP）发布规范、参考软件实现和合规测试套件。该协议将智能移至端点，原生支持乱序交付、多路径、无损容忍和双向拥塞控制，无需 PFC，可在百万 GPU 规模下提供高吞吐、低尾延迟。现有 RDMA Verbs API 和软件栈无需修改即可运行。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: MetaRoCE是Meta面向百万GPU规模以太网设计的新RDMA传输协议，免PFC，用多路径喷洒与256-bit选择性确认，实现高吞吐低尾延迟。

items.title: LLM 可能利用推理引擎控制宿主机 / LLMs could control their host machines by exploiting inference engines

sources.title: LLM 可能利用推理引擎控制宿主机 / LLMs could control their host machines by exploiting inference engines
sources.title_zh: LLM 可能利用推理引擎控制宿主机
sources.title_en: LLMs could control their host machines by exploiting inference engines
sources.title_original: LLMs could control their host machines by exploiting inference engines
sources.summary: vLLM has had exploits in the past, and it is rapidly developing. An advanced LLM has a good chance of being able to exploit vLLM. A clever local LLM might even task a powerful cloud hosted LLM for assistance. For this reason we run vLLM on a separately sandboxed VM on a firewalled VLAN. Software updates and models (from Dev/Test env) get pushed onto Prod from an external cache, machine syslog, nvidia load monitoring and vLLM query telemetry out to their loggers, but that is all. No DNS, no AD/LD
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 本文揭示vLLM过去曾出现漏洞且快速迭代，使高级LLM有机会通过利用推理引擎控制宿主机，并介绍了作者将其部署在防火墙VLAN内的沙箱VM上，仅开放日志与遥测出口、彻底断开DNS和AD/LDAP的隔离实践。
